cases.label: 정상 값·호출 순서·횟수를 보존한다
cases.probe: const calls=[]; const original={count:2}; const result=submission.runWithCleanup(()=>{calls.push('operation');return original;},()=>{calls.push('cleanup');return 'ignored';}); observe({same:result===original,calls});

cases.label: 콜백 타입 오류에서는 어떤 작업도 시작하지 않는다
cases.probe: let calls=0; const names=[]; for(const args of [[null,()=>{calls++;}],[()=>{calls++;},null],[1,2]]){try{submission.runWithCleanup(...args);names.push('returned');}catch(error){names.push(error.name);}} observe({names,calls});

cases.label: 작업 실패에 문맥과 원래 cause를 남긴다
cases.probe: const reason=new RangeError('out of stock'); let cleaned=0; let result; try{submission.runWithCleanup(()=>{throw reason;},()=>{cleaned++;});result={returned:true};}catch(error){result={name:error.name,code:error.code,causeSame:error.cause===reason,isError:error instanceof Error,causeOwn:Object.hasOwn(error,'cause'),causeEnumerable:Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(error,'cause')?.enumerable};} observe({result,cleaned});

cases.label: undefined·null·false 등 모든 throw 값을 실패로 보존한다
cases.probe: const reasons=[undefined,null,false,0,'',Symbol('reason'),{code:'raw'}]; let cleaned=0; const results=[]; for(const reason of reasons){try{submission.runWithCleanup(()=>{throw reason;},()=>{cleaned++;});results.push(false);}catch(error){results.push(error.name==='OperationError'&&error.code==='OPERATION_FAILED'&&Object.hasOwn(error,'cause')&&Object.is(error.cause,reason));}} observe({results,cleaned});

cases.label: 작업 성공 뒤 정리 실패를 성공으로 숨기지 않는다
cases.probe: const reason={code:'CLOSE_FAILED'}; const calls=[]; let result; try{submission.runWithCleanup(()=>{calls.push('operation');return 42;},()=>{calls.push('cleanup');throw reason;});result={returned:true};}catch(error){result={isError:error instanceof Error,name:error.name,code:error.code,causeSame:error.cause===reason};} observe({result,calls});

cases.label: 작업·정리가 모두 실패하면 두 원인을 순서대로 보존한다
cases.probe: const primary=new Error('write'); const secondary=new Error('close'); const calls=[]; let result; try{submission.runWithCleanup(()=>{calls.push('operation');throw primary;},()=>{calls.push('cleanup');throw secondary;});result={returned:true};}catch(error){result={aggregate:error instanceof AggregateError,name:error.name,count:error.errors?.length,primary:error.errors?.[0]===primary,secondary:error.errors?.[1]===secondary,causeSame:error.cause===primary};} observe({result,calls});

cases.label: 두 실패가 falsy여도 AggregateError로 남긴다
cases.probe: let result; try{submission.runWithCleanup(()=>{throw undefined;},()=>{throw null;});result={returned:true};}catch(error){result={aggregate:error instanceof AggregateError,count:error.errors?.length,firstUndefined:error.errors?.[0]===undefined,secondNull:error.errors?.[1]===null,causeOwn:Object.hasOwn(error,'cause'),causeUndefined:error.cause===undefined};} observe(result);
